runtimeErrorCheck.note: On current Production deployment dpl_9h5jweHLmzLk1dyJ1F1HDJDEdBA1, the second browser run's POST /api/rooms returned 503 after a classified database timeout at 20.156 seconds. The follow-up diagnostics change adds safe pg pool occupancy and labels each room-create database step to distinguish local pool wait from a slow create/participant/view query.

Production multiplayer works in a successful run but is not reliable; diagnose the intermittent database timeout and keep release gates open.

database.pollingEstimate: Source-traced 2026-11-05: each successful PrismaRoomStore.getRoom call performs one Prisma Client participant.findFirst with relationLoadStrategy=join. Prisma counts each Prisma Client query as one operation regardless of internal SQL count. At the configured 30-second interval this is 172,800 room-poll operations/month for two continuously open tabs and 345,600 for four. A two-hour guest match uses about 480 room-poll operations for two players or 960 for four, before setup/actions/reconnects. Each visible signed-in account with presence opted in sends one heartbeat every 30 seconds; each calls one updateMany, adding about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session.
database.note: Owner approved a dedicated Production database on Prisma Free ($0, fixed 200,000-operation shared workspace cap; no paid upgrade or overages). The Production database already exists as abominations-attack-america-production (db_a89s8mlpgynwfwfvqiuhmhrl) and is migrated/serving Production. At 22:22 UTC Prisma Console showed 25,662/200,000 workspace-wide operations and a $0 invoice. The Production-specific meter showed 3,913 operations for this cycle. The Production Backups page showed no backups; Free has no automatic backups. One manual dump/restore drill passed once, but routine backup/restore ownership and cadence remain open.
database.workspacePollingHeadroomAtObservation: At the 2026-11-05 22:22 UTC workspace observation of 25,662/200,000, 174,338 operations remained. Source-based poll-only estimates fit about 363 two-hour two-player guest sessions (480 room polls each) or 181 two-hour four-player guest sessions (960 room polls each) before all other workspace and app queries; four tabs left open continuously would add 345,600 polls/month and exceed the shared cap. Four visible opted-in accounts would add about 480 presence heartbeat operations per two-hour session. These are code and billing-definition estimates, not an isolated meter test or capacity acceptance.
